subject: use reactiveValue to update 'value' parameter in inputs

messages.author: 4a86d6a0cc12009d
messages.subject: use reactiveValue to update 'value' parameter in inputs
parts:
Hi,
As the subject says, I'm trying to update the value of inputs using a reactiveValue.  The application prompts the user to build a complex list object by answering a series of questions, but I would like to also allow the user to update the entire list by reading an object off the disk.

I've been trying to use renderUI and some observers to achieve this end, but have come up short. 

In the attached ui and server, I have tried to boil the problem down to a single textInput and single list element.  

If anybody has any insight into this problem, I would greatly appreciate it.

Thanks,
allan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: use reactiveValue to update 'value' parameter in inputs
parts: Don't use uiOutput/renderUI to set the value of textInput("tin"). Instead, add an updateTextInput(session, "tin", value = rValues$mylist$a) call to the observeEvent() you already have.
